64 def _check_limits(agent: "Agent", limits: Limits | None) -> StopReason | None:
65     """Evaluate per-invocation budget caps against the current invocation's metrics.
66 
67     Reads from ``EventLoopMetrics.latest_agent_invocation`` (scoped to the current
68     invocation) so caps don't fire prematurely on the second invoke against a reused
69     agent. Priority on simultaneous trip: turns -> total_tokens -> output_tokens.
70 
71     Args:
72         agent: The agent whose metrics to read.
73         limits: The configured caps, or ``None`` for no caps.
74 
75     Returns:
76         The matching ``StopReason`` if a cap has been reached, otherwise ``None``.
77     """
78     if not limits:
79         return None
80     invocation = agent.event_loop_metrics.latest_agent_invocation
81     if invocation is None:
82         return None
83 
84     cycle_count = len(invocation.cycles)
85     output_tokens = invocation.usage.get("outputTokens", 0)
86     total_tokens = invocation.usage.get("totalTokens", 0)
87 
88     turns_cap = limits.get("turns")
89     if turns_cap is not None and cycle_count >= turns_cap:
90         return "limit_turns"
91     total_cap = limits.get("total_tokens")
92     if total_cap is not None and total_tokens >= total_cap:
93         return "limit_total_tokens"
94     output_cap = limits.get("output_tokens")
95     if output_cap is not None and output_tokens >= output_cap:
96         return "limit_output_tokens"
97     return None

100 def _has_tool_use_in_latest_message(messages: "Messages") -> bool:
101     """Check if the latest message contains any ToolUse content blocks.
102 
103     Args:
104         messages: List of messages in the conversation.
105 
106     Returns:
107         True if the latest message contains at least one ToolUse content block, False otherwise.
108     """
109     if len(messages) > 0:
110         latest_message = messages[-1]
111         content_blocks = latest_message.get("content", [])
112 
113         for content_block in content_blocks:
114             if "toolUse" in content_block:
115                 return True
116 
117     return False

120 async def _estimate_input_tokens(agent: "Agent") -> int:
121     """Estimate the input token count for the next model call.
122 
123     Reads inputTokens + outputTokens from the last assistant message's metadata as a known
124     baseline, then estimates only new messages added after it. Falls back to full estimation
125     when no metadata is available (cold start or first call). On cold start, tool specs are
126     resolved lazily so that the caller does not need to resolve them before BeforeModelCallEvent.
127 
128     Args:
129         agent: The agent instance with messages and model.
130 
131     Returns:
132         Estimated input token count.
133     """
134     messages = agent.messages
135 
136     # Find the last assistant message with usage metadata
137     last_assistant_idx = -1
138     for i, msg in reversed(list(enumerate(messages))):
139         if msg.get("role") == "assistant" and msg.get("metadata", {}).get("usage"):
140             last_assistant_idx = i
141             break
142 
143     if last_assistant_idx >= 0:
144         usage = messages[last_assistant_idx]["metadata"]["usage"]
145         known_baseline = usage["inputTokens"] + usage["outputTokens"]
146         new_messages = messages[last_assistant_idx + 1 :]
147         if not new_messages:
148             return known_baseline
149         # System prompt and tool spec tokens are already included in the baseline
150         return known_baseline + await agent.model.count_tokens(new_messages)
151 
152     # Cold start: resolve tool specs lazily for estimation only
153     tool_specs = agent.tool_registry.get_all_tool_specs()
154     return await agent.model.count_tokens(
155         messages,
156         tool_specs=tool_specs,
157         system_prompt=agent.system_prompt,
158         system_prompt_content=agent._system_prompt_content,
159     )

183 async def event_loop_cycle(
184     agent: "Agent",
185     invocation_state: dict[str, Any],
186     structured_output_context: StructuredOutputContext | None = None,
187     limits: Limits | None = None,
188 ) -> AsyncGenerator[TypedEvent, None]:
189     """Execute a single cycle of the event loop.
190 
191     This core function processes a single conversation turn, handling model inference, tool execution, and error
192     recovery. It manages the entire lifecycle of a conversation turn, including:
193 
194     1. Initializing cycle state and metrics
195     2. Checking execution limits
196     3. Processing messages with the model
197     4. Handling tool execution requests
198     5. Managing recursive calls for multi-turn tool interactions
199     6. Collecting and reporting metrics
200     7. Error handling and recovery
201 
202     Args:
203         agent: The agent for which the cycle is being executed.
204         invocation_state: Additional arguments including:
205 
206             - request_state: State maintained across cycles
207             - event_loop_cycle_id: Unique ID for this cycle
208             - event_loop_cycle_span: Current tracing Span for this cycle
209         structured_output_context: Optional context for structured output management.
210         limits: Optional per-invocation budget caps. Checked at the top of this cycle
211             (after tools from the previous cycle have run to completion). See
212             :class:`~strands.types.agent.Limits`.
213 
214     Yields:
215         Model and tool stream events. The final ``EventLoopStopEvent`` payload
216         (``event["stop"]``) is a 7-tuple:
217 
218             - StopReason: Reason the model stopped generating (e.g., "tool_use", "checkpoint")
219             - Message: The generated message from the model
220             - EventLoopMetrics: Updated metrics for the event loop
221             - Any: Updated request state
222             - Sequence[Interrupt] | None: Interrupts raised during the cycle, if any
223             - BaseModel | None: Structured output result, if any
224             - Checkpoint | None: Checkpoint captured when stop_reason == "checkpoint"
225 
226     Raises:
227         EventLoopException: If an error occurs during execution
228         ContextWindowOverflowException: If the input is too large for the model
229     """
230     structured_output_context = structured_output_context or StructuredOutputContext()
231 
232     # Caps are positive and use >= semantics, so a trip implies at least one prior cycle
233     # ran — meaning agent.messages[-1] exists.
234     limit_stop_reason = _check_limits(agent, limits)
235     if limit_stop_reason is not None:
236         if "request_state" not in invocation_state:
237             invocation_state["request_state"] = {}
238         yield EventLoopStopEvent(
239             limit_stop_reason,
240             agent.messages[-1],
241             agent.event_loop_metrics,
242             invocation_state["request_state"],
243         )
244         return
245 
246     # Initialize cycle state
247     invocation_state["event_loop_cycle_id"] = uuid.uuid4()
248 
249     # Initialize state and get cycle trace
250     if "request_state" not in invocation_state:
251         invocation_state["request_state"] = {}
252 
253     # Consume the resume marker (one-shot).
254     resume_context = agent._checkpoint
255     if resume_context is not None:
256         agent._checkpoint = None
257         # after_tools means that cycle finished; resume increments cycle_index.
258         next_cycle = (
259             resume_context.cycle_index + 1 if resume_context.position == "after_tools" else resume_context.cycle_index
260         )
261         agent._checkpoint_cycle_index = next_cycle
262         agent._checkpoint_resume_position = resume_context.position
263 
264     attributes = {"event_loop_cycle_id": str(invocation_state.get("event_loop_cycle_id"))}
265     cycle_start_time, cycle_trace = agent.event_loop_metrics.start_cycle(attributes=attributes)
266     invocation_state["event_loop_cycle_trace"] = cycle_trace
267 
268     yield StartEvent()
269     yield StartEventLoopEvent()
270 
271     # Create tracer span for this event loop cycle
272     tracer = get_tracer()
273     cycle_span = tracer.start_event_loop_cycle_span(
274         invocation_state=invocation_state,
275         messages=agent.messages,
276         parent_span=agent.trace_span,
277         custom_trace_attributes=agent.trace_attributes,
278     )
279     invocation_state["event_loop_cycle_span"] = cycle_span
280 
281     with trace_api.use_span(cycle_span, end_on_exit=False):
282         try:
283             # Skipping model invocation if in interrupt state as interrupts are currently only supported for tool calls.
284             if agent._interrupt_state.activated:
285                 stop_reason: StopReason = "tool_use"
286                 message = agent._interrupt_state.context["tool_use_message"]
287             # Skip model invocation if the latest message contains ToolUse
288             elif _has_tool_use_in_latest_message(agent.messages):
289                 stop_reason = "tool_use"
290                 message = agent.messages[-1]
291             else:
292                 model_events = _handle_model_execution(
293                     agent, cycle_span, cycle_trace, invocation_state, tracer, structured_output_context
294                 )
295                 async for model_event in model_events:
296                     if not isinstance(model_event, ModelStopReason):
297                         yield model_event
298 
299                 stop_reason, message, *_ = model_event["stop"]
300                 yield ModelMessageEvent(message=message)
301         except Exception as e:
302             tracer.end_span_with_error(cycle_span, str(e), e)
303             raise
304 
305         try:
306             if stop_reason == "max_tokens":
307                 """
308                 Handle max_tokens limit reached by the model.
309 
310                 When the model reaches its maximum token limit, this represents a potentially unrecoverable
311                 state where the model's response was truncated. By default, Strands fails hard with an
312                 MaxTokensReachedException to maintain consistency with other failure types.
313                 """
314                 raise MaxTokensReachedException(
315                     message=(
316                         "Agent has reached an unrecoverable state due to max_tokens limit. "
317                         "For more information see: "
318                         "https://strandsagents.com/docs/user-guide/concepts/agents/agent-loop/#maxtokensreachedexception"
319                     )
320                 )
321 
322             if stop_reason == "tool_use":
323                 # Emit after_model checkpoint, unless we just resumed from one.
324                 if agent._checkpointing and not agent._cancel_signal.is_set():
325                     resume_position = agent._checkpoint_resume_position
326                     agent._checkpoint_resume_position = None
327                     if resume_position != "after_model":
328                         cycle_index = agent._checkpoint_cycle_index
329                         agent.event_loop_metrics.end_cycle(cycle_start_time, cycle_trace)
330                         if cycle_span:
331                             tracer.end_event_loop_cycle_span(span=cycle_span, message=message)
332                         yield _build_checkpoint_stop_event(
333                             agent=agent,
334                             position="after_model",
335                             cycle_index=cycle_index,
336                             message=message,
337                             request_state=invocation_state["request_state"],
338                         )
339                         return
340 
341                 # Handle tool execution
342                 tool_events = _handle_tool_execution(
343                     stop_reason,
344                     message,
345                     agent=agent,
346                     cycle_trace=cycle_trace,
347                     cycle_span=cycle_span,
348                     cycle_start_time=cycle_start_time,
349                     invocation_state=invocation_state,
350                     tracer=tracer,
351                     structured_output_context=structured_output_context,
352                     limits=limits,
353                 )
354                 async for tool_event in tool_events:
355                     yield tool_event
356 
357                 return
358 
359             # End the cycle and return results
360             agent.event_loop_metrics.end_cycle(cycle_start_time, cycle_trace, attributes)
361 
362             # Force structured output tool call if LLM didn't use it automatically
363             if structured_output_context.is_enabled and stop_reason == "end_turn":
364                 if structured_output_context.force_attempted:
365                     raise StructuredOutputException(
366                         "The model failed to invoke the structured output tool even after it was forced."
367                     )
368                 structured_output_context.set_forced_mode()
369                 logger.debug("Forcing structured output tool")
370                 await agent._append_messages(
371                     {"role": "user", "content": [{"text": structured_output_context.structured_output_prompt}]}
372                 )
373 
374                 tracer.end_event_loop_cycle_span(cycle_span, message)
375                 events = recurse_event_loop(
376                     agent=agent,
377                     invocation_state=invocation_state,
378                     structured_output_context=structured_output_context,
379                     limits=limits,
380                 )
381                 async for typed_event in events:
382                     yield typed_event
383                 return
384 
385             tracer.end_event_loop_cycle_span(cycle_span, message)
386             yield EventLoopStopEvent(stop_reason, message, agent.event_loop_metrics, invocation_state["request_state"])
387         except (
388             StructuredOutputException,
389             EventLoopException,
390             ContextWindowOverflowException,
391             MaxTokensReachedException,
392         ) as e:
393             # These exceptions should bubble up directly rather than get wrapped in an EventLoopException
394             tracer.end_span_with_error(cycle_span, str(e), e)
395             raise
396         except Exception as e:
397             tracer.end_span_with_error(cycle_span, str(e), e)
398             # Handle any other exceptions
399             yield ForceStopEvent(reason=e)
400             logger.exception("cycle failed")
401             raise EventLoopException(e, invocation_state["request_state"]) from e
402

404 async def recurse_event_loop(
405     agent: "Agent",
406     invocation_state: dict[str, Any],
407     structured_output_context: StructuredOutputContext | None = None,
408     limits: Limits | None = None,
409 ) -> AsyncGenerator[TypedEvent, None]:
410     """Make a recursive call to event_loop_cycle with the current state.
411 
412     This function is used when the event loop needs to continue processing after tool execution.
413 
414     Args:
415         agent: Agent for which the recursive call is being made.
416         invocation_state: Arguments to pass through event_loop_cycle
417         structured_output_context: Optional context for structured output management.
418         limits: Optional per-invocation budget caps. See :class:`~strands.types.agent.Limits`.
419 
420     Yields:
421         Results from event_loop_cycle where the last result contains:
422 
423             - StopReason: Reason the model stopped generating
424             - Message: The generated message from the model
425             - EventLoopMetrics: Updated metrics for the event loop
426             - Any: Updated request state
427     """
428     cycle_trace = invocation_state["event_loop_cycle_trace"]
429 
430     # Recursive call trace
431     recursive_trace = Trace("Recursive call", parent_id=cycle_trace.id)
432     cycle_trace.add_child(recursive_trace)
433 
434     yield StartEvent()
435 
436     events = event_loop_cycle(
437         agent=agent,
438         invocation_state=invocation_state,
439         structured_output_context=structured_output_context,
440         limits=limits,
441     )
442     async for event in events:
443         yield event
444 
445     recursive_trace.end()

448 async def _handle_model_execution(
449     agent: "Agent",
450     cycle_span: Any,
451     cycle_trace: Trace,
452     invocation_state: dict[str, Any],
453     tracer: Tracer,
454     structured_output_context: StructuredOutputContext,
455 ) -> AsyncGenerator[TypedEvent, None]:
456     """Handle model execution with retry logic for throttling exceptions.
457 
458     Executes the model inference with automatic retry handling for throttling exceptions.
459     Manages tracing, hooks, and metrics collection throughout the process.
460 
461     Args:
462         agent: The agent executing the model.
463         cycle_span: Span object for tracing the cycle.
464         cycle_trace: Trace object for the current event loop cycle.
465         invocation_state: State maintained across cycles.
466         tracer: Tracer instance for span management.
467         structured_output_context: Context for structured output management.
468 
469     Yields:
470         Model stream events and throttle events during retries.
471 
472     Raises:
473         ModelThrottledException: If max retry attempts are exceeded.
474         Exception: Any other model execution errors.
475     """
476     # Create a trace for the stream_messages call
477     stream_trace = Trace("stream_messages", parent_id=cycle_trace.id)
478     cycle_trace.add_child(stream_trace)
479 
480     # Retry loop - actual retry logic is handled by retry_strategy hook
481     # Hooks control when to stop retrying via the event.retry flag
482     while True:
483         try:
484             # Estimate input tokens for the upcoming model call (non-fatal)
485             projected_input_tokens: int | None = None
486             try:
487                 projected_input_tokens = await _estimate_input_tokens(agent)
488             except Exception as e:
489                 logger.debug("error=<%s> | token estimation failed, proceeding without estimate", e)
490 
491             before_model_call_event = BeforeModelCallEvent(
492                 agent=agent,
493                 invocation_state=invocation_state,
494                 projected_input_tokens=projected_input_tokens,
495             )
496             await agent.hooks.invoke_callbacks_async(before_model_call_event)
497 
498             if before_model_call_event.cancel:
499                 cancel_text = (
500                     before_model_call_event.cancel
501                     if isinstance(before_model_call_event.cancel, str)
502                     else "model call denied by hook"
503                 )
504                 message: Message = {"role": "assistant", "content": [{"text": cancel_text}]}
505                 stop_reason: StopReason = "end_turn"
506                 usage: Usage = {"inputTokens": 0, "outputTokens": 0, "totalTokens": 0}
507                 metrics: Metrics = {"latencyMs": 0}
508 
509                 after_model_call_event = AfterModelCallEvent(
510                     agent=agent,
511                     invocation_state=invocation_state,
512                     stop_response=AfterModelCallEvent.ModelStopResponse(
513                         stop_reason=stop_reason,
514                         message=message,
515                     ),
516                 )
517                 await agent.hooks.invoke_callbacks_async(after_model_call_event)
518 
519                 if after_model_call_event.retry:
520                     continue
521                 yield ModelStopReason(stop_reason=stop_reason, message=message, usage=usage, metrics=metrics)
522                 break
523 
524             if structured_output_context.forced_mode:
525                 tool_spec = structured_output_context.get_tool_spec()
526                 tool_specs = [tool_spec] if tool_spec else []
527             else:
528                 tool_specs = agent.tool_registry.get_all_tool_specs()
529 
530             # Build middleware context with defensive copies to prevent accidental mutation.
531             # invocation_state is intentionally shared by reference (hooks/tools write to it).
532             system_prompt_value = (
533                 agent._system_prompt_content if agent._system_prompt_content is not None else agent.system_prompt
534             )
535             middleware_context = InvokeModelContext(
536                 agent=agent,
537                 messages=copy.deepcopy(agent.messages),
538                 system_prompt=copy.deepcopy(system_prompt_value),
539                 tool_specs=copy.deepcopy(tool_specs),
540                 tool_choice=copy.deepcopy(structured_output_context.tool_choice),
541                 invocation_state=invocation_state,
542                 projected_input_tokens=projected_input_tokens,
543             )
544 
545             # Run through middleware chain (terminal includes span tracking)
546             model_result: InvokeModelResult | None = None
547             async for event in agent._middleware_registry.invoke(
548                 InvokeModelStage,
549                 middleware_context,
550                 _make_invoke_model_terminal(agent, cycle_span, tracer),
551             ):
552                 if isinstance(event, MiddlewareResult):
553                     model_result = event.value
554                 else:
555                     yield event
556 
557             if model_result is None:
558                 raise RuntimeError(
559                     "Middleware chain did not produce a MiddlewareResult. "
560                     "Ensure all middleware forwards the result from next()."
561                 )
562             stop_reason = model_result.stop_reason
563             message = model_result.message
564             usage = model_result.usage
565             metrics = model_result.metrics
566 
567             invocation_state.setdefault("request_state", {})
568 
569             # Attach metadata to the assistant message immediately so it's
570             # available to all downstream consumers (hooks, events, state).
571             message["metadata"] = {
572                 "usage": usage,
573                 "metrics": metrics,
574             }
575 
576             after_model_call_event = AfterModelCallEvent(
577                 agent=agent,
578                 invocation_state=invocation_state,
579                 stop_response=AfterModelCallEvent.ModelStopResponse(
580                     stop_reason=stop_reason,
581                     message=message,
582                 ),
583             )
584 
585             await agent.hooks.invoke_callbacks_async(after_model_call_event)
586 
587             # Check if hooks want to retry the model call
588             if after_model_call_event.retry:
589                 logger.debug(
590                     "stop_reason=<%s>, retry_requested=<True> | hook requested model retry",
591                     stop_reason,
592                 )
593                 continue  # Retry the model call
594 
595             if stop_reason == "max_tokens":
596                 message = recover_message_on_max_tokens_reached(message)
597 
598             break  # Success! Break out of retry loop
599 
600         except Exception as e:
601             after_model_call_event = AfterModelCallEvent(
602                 agent=agent,
603                 invocation_state=invocation_state,
604                 exception=e,
605             )
606             await agent.hooks.invoke_callbacks_async(after_model_call_event)
607 
608             # Emit backwards-compatible events if retry strategy supports it
609             if (
610                 isinstance(agent._retry_strategy, ModelRetryStrategy)
611                 and agent._retry_strategy._backwards_compatible_event_to_yield
612             ):
613                 yield agent._retry_strategy._backwards_compatible_event_to_yield
614 
615             # Check if hooks want to retry the model call
616             if after_model_call_event.retry:
617                 logger.debug(
618                     "exception=<%s>, retry_requested=<True> | hook requested model retry",
619                     type(e).__name__,
620                 )
621 
622                 continue  # Retry the model call
623 
624             # No retry requested, raise the exception
625             yield ForceStopEvent(reason=e)
626             raise e
627 
628     try:
629         # Add message in trace and mark the end of the stream messages trace
630         stream_trace.add_message(message)
631         stream_trace.end()
632 
633         # Add the response message to the conversation
634         agent.messages.append(message)
635         await agent.hooks.invoke_callbacks_async(MessageAddedEvent(agent=agent, message=message))
636 
637         # Update metrics
638         agent.event_loop_metrics.update_usage(usage)
639         agent.event_loop_metrics.update_metrics(metrics)
640 
641     except Exception as e:
642         yield ForceStopEvent(reason=e)
643         logger.exception("cycle failed")
644         raise EventLoopException(e, invocation_state["request_state"]) from e

647 def _make_invoke_model_terminal(
648     agent: "Agent", cycle_span: Any, tracer: Tracer
649 ) -> "Callable[[InvokeModelContext], AsyncGenerator[Any, None]]":
650     """Create the terminal function for InvokeModelStage middleware."""
651 
652     async def terminal(ctx: InvokeModelContext) -> AsyncGenerator[Any, None]:
653         system_prompt_str, system_prompt_content = split_system_prompt(ctx.system_prompt)
654 
655         model_id = agent.model.config.get("model_id") if hasattr(agent.model, "config") else None
656         model_invoke_span = tracer.start_model_invoke_span(
657             messages=ctx.messages,
658             parent_span=cycle_span,
659             model_id=model_id,
660             custom_trace_attributes=agent.trace_attributes,
661             system_prompt=system_prompt_str,
662             system_prompt_content=system_prompt_content,
663         )
664         with trace_api.use_span(model_invoke_span, end_on_exit=False):
665             try:
666                 async for event in stream_messages(
667                     agent.model,
668                     system_prompt_str,
669                     ctx.messages,
670                     ctx.tool_specs,
671                     system_prompt_content=system_prompt_content,
672                     tool_choice=ctx.tool_choice,
673                     invocation_state=ctx.invocation_state,
674                     model_state=agent._model_state,
675                     cancel_signal=agent._cancel_signal,
676                 ):
677                     yield event
678 
679                 stop_reason, message, usage, metrics = event["stop"]
680                 tracer.end_model_invoke_span(model_invoke_span, message, usage, metrics, stop_reason)
681                 yield MiddlewareResult(
682                     InvokeModelResult(
683                         stop_reason=stop_reason,
684                         message=message,
685                         usage=usage,
686                         metrics=metrics,
687                     )
688                 )
689             except Exception as e:
690                 tracer.end_span_with_error(model_invoke_span, str(e), e)
691                 raise
692 
693     return terminal
694

696 async def _handle_tool_execution(
697     stop_reason: StopReason,
698     message: Message,
699     agent: "Agent",
700     cycle_trace: Trace,
701     cycle_span: Any,
702     cycle_start_time: float,
703     invocation_state: dict[str, Any],
704     tracer: Tracer,
705     structured_output_context: StructuredOutputContext,
706     limits: Limits | None = None,
707 ) -> AsyncGenerator[TypedEvent, None]:
708     """Handles the execution of tools requested by the model during an event loop cycle.
709 
710     Args:
711         stop_reason: The reason the model stopped generating.
712         message: The message from the model that may contain tool use requests.
713         agent: Agent for which tools are being executed.
714         cycle_trace: Trace object for the current event loop cycle.
715         cycle_span: Span object for tracing the cycle (type may vary).
716         cycle_start_time: Start time of the current cycle.
717         invocation_state: Additional keyword arguments, including request state.
718         tracer: Tracer instance for span management.
719         structured_output_context: Optional context for structured output management.
720         limits: Optional per-invocation budget caps. See :class:`~strands.types.agent.Limits`.
721 
722     Yields:
723         Tool stream events along with events yielded from a recursive call to the event loop. The last event is a tuple
724         containing:
725             - The stop reason,
726             - The updated message,
727             - The updated event loop metrics,
728             - The updated request state.
729     """
730     tool_uses: list[ToolUse] = []
731     tool_results: list[ToolResult] = []
732     invalid_tool_use_ids: list[str] = []
733 
734     validate_and_prepare_tools(message, tool_uses, tool_results, invalid_tool_use_ids)
735     tool_uses = [tool_use for tool_use in tool_uses if tool_use.get("toolUseId") not in invalid_tool_use_ids]
736 
737     if agent._interrupt_state.activated:
738         tool_results.extend(agent._interrupt_state.context["tool_results"])
739 
740         # Filter to only the interrupted tools when resuming from interrupt (tool uses without results)
741         tool_use_ids = {tool_result["toolUseId"] for tool_result in tool_results}
742         tool_uses = [tool_use for tool_use in tool_uses if tool_use["toolUseId"] not in tool_use_ids]
743 
744     interrupts = []
745 
746     # Check for cancellation before tool execution
747     # Add tool_result for each tool_use to maintain valid conversation state
748     if agent._cancel_signal.is_set():
749         logger.debug("tool_count=<%d> | cancellation detected before tool execution", len(tool_uses))
750 
751         # Create cancellation tool_result for each tool_use to avoid invalid message state
752         # (tool_use without tool_result would be rejected on next invocation)
753         for tool_use in tool_uses:
754             cancel_result: ToolResult = {
755                 "toolUseId": str(tool_use.get("toolUseId")),
756                 "status": "error",
757                 "content": [{"text": "Tool execution cancelled"}],
758             }
759             tool_results.append(cancel_result)
760 
761         # Add tool results message to conversation if any tools were cancelled
762         cancelled_tool_result_message: Message | None = None
763         if tool_results:
764             _cancelled_msg: Message = {
765                 "role": "user",
766                 "content": [{"toolResult": result} for result in tool_results],
767             }
768             cancelled_tool_result_message = _cancelled_msg
769             agent.messages.append(_cancelled_msg)
770             await agent.hooks.invoke_callbacks_async(MessageAddedEvent(agent=agent, message=_cancelled_msg))
771             yield ToolResultMessageEvent(message=_cancelled_msg)
772 
773         agent.event_loop_metrics.end_cycle(cycle_start_time, cycle_trace)
774         yield EventLoopStopEvent(
775             "cancelled",
776             message,
777             agent.event_loop_metrics,
778             invocation_state["request_state"],
779         )
780         if cycle_span:
781             tracer.end_event_loop_cycle_span(
782                 span=cycle_span, message=message, tool_result_message=cancelled_tool_result_message
783             )
784         return
785 
786     tool_events = agent.tool_executor._execute(
787         agent, tool_uses, tool_results, cycle_trace, cycle_span, invocation_state, structured_output_context
788     )
789     async for tool_event in tool_events:
790         if isinstance(tool_event, ToolInterruptEvent):
791             interrupts.extend(tool_event["tool_interrupt_event"]["interrupts"])
792 
793         yield tool_event
794 
795     structured_output_result = None
796     if structured_output_context.is_enabled:
797         if structured_output_result := structured_output_context.extract_result(tool_uses):
798             yield StructuredOutputEvent(structured_output=structured_output_result)
799             structured_output_context.stop_loop = True
800 
801     invocation_state["event_loop_parent_cycle_id"] = invocation_state["event_loop_cycle_id"]
802 
803     if interrupts:
804         # Session state stored on AfterInvocationEvent.
805         agent._interrupt_state.context = {"tool_use_message": message, "tool_results": tool_results}
806         agent._interrupt_state.activate()
807 
808         agent.event_loop_metrics.end_cycle(cycle_start_time, cycle_trace)
809         yield EventLoopStopEvent(
810             "interrupt",
811             message,
812             agent.event_loop_metrics,
813             invocation_state["request_state"],
814             interrupts,
815             structured_output=structured_output_result,
816         )
817         # End the cycle span before yielding the recursive cycle.
818         if cycle_span:
819             tracer.end_event_loop_cycle_span(span=cycle_span, message=message)
820 
821         return
822 
823     agent._interrupt_state.deactivate()
824 
825     tool_result_message: Message = {
826         "role": "user",
827         "content": [{"toolResult": result} for result in tool_results],
828     }
829 
830     agent.messages.append(tool_result_message)
831     await agent.hooks.invoke_callbacks_async(MessageAddedEvent(agent=agent, message=tool_result_message))
832 
833     yield ToolResultMessageEvent(message=tool_result_message)
834 
835     # End the cycle span before yielding the recursive cycle.
836     if cycle_span:
837         tracer.end_event_loop_cycle_span(span=cycle_span, message=message, tool_result_message=tool_result_message)
838 
839     agent.event_loop_metrics.end_cycle(cycle_start_time, cycle_trace)
840 
841     if invocation_state["request_state"].get("stop_event_loop", False) or structured_output_context.stop_loop:
842         yield EventLoopStopEvent(
843             stop_reason,
844             message,
845             agent.event_loop_metrics,
846             invocation_state["request_state"],
847             structured_output=structured_output_result,
848         )
849         return
850 
851     # Emit after_tools checkpoint. Only fires on tool_use cycles: a model that
852     # returns end_turn first never reaches this branch.
853     if agent._checkpointing and not agent._cancel_signal.is_set():
854         cycle_index = agent._checkpoint_cycle_index
855         agent._checkpoint_cycle_index = cycle_index + 1
856         yield _build_checkpoint_stop_event(
857             agent=agent,
858             position="after_tools",
859             cycle_index=cycle_index,
860             message=message,
861             request_state=invocation_state["request_state"],
862         )
863         return
864 
865     # If checkpointing is on and cancel suppressed the checkpoint above, emit
866     # "cancelled" now to avoid an extra model call.
867     if agent._checkpointing and agent._cancel_signal.is_set():
868         yield EventLoopStopEvent(
869             "cancelled",
870             message,
871             agent.event_loop_metrics,
872             invocation_state["request_state"],
873         )
874         return
875 
876     events = recurse_event_loop(
877         agent=agent,
878         invocation_state=invocation_state,
879         structured_output_context=structured_output_context,
880         limits=limits,
881     )
882     async for event in events:
883         yield event

21 class MaxTokensReachedException(Exception):
22     """Exception raised when the model reaches its maximum token generation limit.
23 
24     This exception is raised when the model stops generating tokens because it has reached the maximum number of
25     tokens allowed for output generation. This can occur when the model's max_tokens parameter is set too low for
26     the complexity of the response, or when the model naturally reaches its configured output limit during generation.
27     """
28 
29     def __init__(self, message: str):
30         """Initialize the exception with an error message and the incomplete message object.
31 
32         Args:
33             message: The error message describing the token limit issue
34         """
35         super().__init__(message)
intended_behavior: Extend the exception class to accept an optional partial message parameter, store it for caller access, and modify the exception message to indicate this is a recoverable condition.

16 def recover_message_on_max_tokens_reached(message: Message) -> Message:
17     """Recover and clean up messages when max token limits are reached.
18 
19     When a model response is truncated due to maximum token limits, all tool use blocks
20     should be replaced with informative error messages since they may be incomplete or
21     unreliable. This function inspects the message content and:
22 
23     1. Identifies all tool use blocks (regardless of validity)
24     2. Replaces all tool uses with informative error messages
25     3. Preserves all non-tool content blocks (text, images, etc.)
26     4. Returns a cleaned message suitable for conversation history
27 
28     This recovery mechanism ensures that the conversation can continue gracefully even when
29     model responses are truncated, providing clear feedback about what happened and preventing
30     potentially incomplete or corrupted tool executions.
31 
32     Args:
33         message: The potentially incomplete message from the model that was truncated
34                 due to max token limits.
35 
36     Returns:
37         A cleaned Message with all tool uses replaced by explanatory text content.
38         The returned message maintains the same role as the input message.
39 
40     Example:
41         If a message contains any tool use (complete or incomplete):
42         ```
43         {"toolUse": {"name": "calculator", "input": {"expression": "2+2"}, "toolUseId": "123"}}
44         ```
45 
46         It will be replaced with:
47         ```
48         {"text": "The selected tool calculator's tool use was incomplete due to maximum token limits being reached."}
49         ```
50     """
51     logger.info("handling max_tokens stop reason - replacing all tool uses with error messages")
52 
53     valid_content: list[ContentBlock] = []
54     for content in message["content"] or []:
55         tool_use: ToolUse | None = content.get("toolUse")
56         if not tool_use:
57             valid_content.append(content)
58             continue
59 
60         # Replace all tool uses with error messages when max_tokens is reached
61         display_name = tool_use.get("name") or "<unknown>"
62         logger.warning("tool_name=<%s> | replacing with error message due to max_tokens truncation.", display_name)
63 
64         valid_content.append(
65             {
66                 "text": f"The selected tool {display_name}'s tool use was incomplete due "
67                 f"to maximum token limits being reached."
68             }
69         )
70 
71     recovered: Message = {"content": valid_content, "role": message["role"]}
72     if "metadata" in message:
73         recovered["metadata"] = message["metadata"]
74     return recovered
intended_behavior: Continue to clean incomplete or corrupted tool use blocks in truncated messages, ensuring a safe partial message is available and integrated with the exception raising mechanism.
